questions.stem: The Contact process (2SO₂ + O₂ ⇌ 2SO₃) operates at only 1-2 atm pressure, despite having more gas moles on the left. Why?

options.text: Because higher pressure would cause the reaction to reverse
Because the yield is already about 99% at atmospheric pressure, so expensive high-pressure equipment is not justified
Because the V₂O₅ catalyst cannot work at high pressure
Because pressure has no effect on this equilibrium

questions.explanation: At 450°C with a V₂O₅ catalyst, the Contact process already achieves about 99% conversion at atmospheric pressure. Using high-pressure equipment would be very expensive and would only marginally improve an already excellent yield, so it is not economically worthwhile.
